message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout that caught me a bit off guard. At first, I was scrambling to find flashlights and my trusty power bank for my phone. But then I decided to embrace the moment instead of fight it. I dug out my favorite lantern, made some hot cocoa on the camp stove, and we huddled together under blankets, sharing stories by soft light. 

It turned into a cozy little event, reminding me that even when the lights go out, we can still create warmth and connection. Have you turned a blackout into a fun memory? I’d love to hear your tips for making the best of unexpected moments like these! ☕
